texts:
Saturday's news, team by team, from a trade in Arizona to Monday night's injury report.

Marvin Harrison Jr. sits vs DET.

DJ Moore is questionable.

Michael Pittman Jr. goes to IR.
#BirdGang #OnePride #BillsMafia #HereWeGo

Arizona is finalizing a trade of Marvin Harrison Jr., per ESPN and NFL Network, and he is inactive Sunday vs DET. He has 5 catches for 85 in four games.

WR43 rest of season for me. Monitor; the trade announcement after Sunday's games.
#BirdGang #OnePride

Michael Wilson has 30 targets the last two games, and more of the outside work stays with him now.

WR7 for me vs DET.

Trey McBride has 10 or more targets in all four games. TE1 for me.
#BirdGang #OnePride

DJ Moore was limited Saturday after two missed days and is questionable for Monday night at LAR. Josh Palmer is out.

Moore stays outside my top 50. Monitor; Monday's inactives at 6:45 PM ET.
#BillsMafia #RamsHouse

Khalil Shakir is WR29 for me @LAR, a high-end WR3 and a high-end flex play.

Keon Coleman played 46 of 59 snaps after Moore left in Week 4. WR40 for me, a low-end flex play to a dart throw.
#BillsMafia #RamsHouse

Puka Nacua caught 9 for 125 in his return. WR2 for me vs BUF.

Kyren Williams played 70 snaps to Blake Corum's 13 in Week 4. RB4 for me.
#RamsHouse #BillsMafia

Pittsburgh put Michael Pittman Jr. on IR Saturday, out at least four games.

DK Metcalf has the outside targets. WR18 for me vs IND, a WR2.

Hold Pittman in an IR spot; a slow return after four games makes him a drop.
#HereWeGo #ForTheShoe

Darius Slayton was downgraded to out @PIT, with Alec Pierce on IR and Keenan Allen questionable after a full Friday.

Josh Downs keeps the slot. WR21 for me, a WR2.
#ForTheShoe #HereWeGo

New England put Mack Hollins on IR for at least four games, with A.J. Brown already there.

Romeo Doubs has 2 TDs since Brown went down. WR26 for me vs LV, a high-end WR3 and a high-end flex play.
#NEPats #RaiderNation

Ashton Jeanty is questionable @NE after no practice Friday with a new foot injury.

RB18 for me this week, an RB2. Have a backup ready and check Sunday's inactives at 11:30 AM ET.
#RaiderNation #NEPats

Washington downgraded Jeremy McNichols to out vs NYG.

Jacory Croskey-Merritt practiced in full Friday after 45 percent of the snaps in London. RB25 for me, a high-end RB3 and a high-end flex play.
#RaiseHail #NYGiants

Malik Nabers caught 6 of 7 for 112 and a TD through a shoulder hit in Week 4. WR13 for me @WAS, borderline WR1/WR2 this week.

Cam Skattebo ran 18 times for 58. RB19 for me, an RB2.
#NYGiants #RaiseHail

Kyle Monangai is out with the turf toe, so Chicago's backfield is D'Andre Swift's. RB11 for me @GB, borderline RB1/RB2 this week.

Colston Loveland drew a team-high 9 targets from Tyson Bagent. TE10 for me.
#DaBears #GoPackGo

London kicks off at 9:30 AM ET, and Saquon Barkley is out.

Will Shipley played 28 of 61 snaps in Week 4. RB22 for me @JAX, an RB2.

Bhayshul Tuten out-snapped Chris Rodriguez Jr. 36 to 15. RB14 for me, borderline RB1/RB2.
#FlyEaglesFly #DUUUVAL

Emanuel Wilson has Seattle's backfield with Zach Charbonnet ruled out. He ran 21 times with 2 TDs in Week 4.

RB16 for me vs SF, an RB2.
#Seahawks #FTTB

Lamar Jackson is out, and Tyler Huntley starts @ATL. Huntley is outside my top 12.

Zay Flowers is questionable after three limited practices with the foot. WR12 for me, borderline WR1/WR2 this week.
#RavensFlock #DirtyBirds

Ja'Marr Chase and Tee Higgins are both questionable @MIA after full Friday practices.

Dohnte Meyers caught 7 for 82 when Chase left in Week 4. WR36 for me, a low-end WR3 and a low-end flex play.
#WhoDey #PhinsUp

Keaton Mitchell out-touched Omarion Hampton 15 to 9 in Week 4.

Hampton is RB27 for me vs DEN, a high-end RB3 and a high-end flex play.

Mitchell is RB34, a low-end RB3 and a low-end flex play.
#BoltUp #BroncosCountry

Breece Hall is out vs CLE. Braelon Allen took all 14 back carries in Week 4.

Allen is RB15 for me this week, an RB2.
#JetUp #DawgPound

Every item from today is on the Pass, with Harrison off the Menu and Monday night's injury report in.

Follow @FF_ChefHazy for Sunday's inactives and pivots, and like this if it helps your lineup.
